[i]Today I declare the annexation of the former Nestor-Sikirsk.

[spoiler=[b]Seine Majestät, der Kaiser, verkündet die Annexion[/b]]

On January 28th, 2025 at 7:00 AM Local Time:

The halls of the Neudresden Imperial Palace were packed with members of the Hochdeutsche aristocracy, joined by state media journalists, priests of the Kaiserliche Kriegskult and members of the Reichswehr leadership. The most important of them, the Hochkaiser, was to give an address on the war in Nestor-Sikirsk. 

As the sun begins to rise on the Palace and the flag of the Kaiserreich billows in the wind, the Kaiser ascends to the imperial throne. On either side of the hall, stand various high ranking officials. General Eisen of the Kaiserliche Armee stands to the right of the Kaiser as Admiral Friedrich von Steinmark stands to the left. Lined along the sides of the hall, visible from the camera is the Emperors Guard who stand in their traditional Pickelhaube. 

When the camera begins to roll, the Kaiser begins his speech;

[i]People of the Empire, 

Once again our armed forces have triumphed over foreign imperial interests. We have completely secured the air and waters surrounding the former Sikirskian colony of Nestor-Sikirsk. The remaining troops of the Sikirskian armed forces and their craven allies have capitulated or been destroyed by the courageous forces of the Reichswehr. 

Today I proclaim that the lands bound to us through history, culture and the blood of our ancestors returns home to the Reich. The annexation of these territories is carried out in the name of unity and continental sovereignty from foreign imperialists. It is our duty and right to place under our protection these regions which are part of our natural heritage. 

God bless the Empire, 

God bless you all,[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]On the Sikirskian Proposal for Peace[/b]]

- Office of the State Kaiserliche Diplomatic Korps -

Upon extensive review, the Kaiserreich accepts the Sikirskian proposal for peace. The Hochkaiser agrees that further suffering is unnecessary and is open to peace talks. However, the Kaiserreich will only enter into peace talks under the following conditions:

The IPEA must remain completely neutral in its management of the peace talks. Should the Kaiserreich believe the IPEA, with its pro-Sikirskian rhetoric, is influencing the talks, peace will immediately be terminated. 

An immediate ceasefire be implemented, with details provided, to help aid negotiations and prevent disruptions. 

The Kaiserreichs annexation of the former Nestor-Sikirsk will be a non-negotiable part of any peace deal. 

Should these terms be agreed to, the Hochkaiser is willing to host the peace talks himself. At the historical imperial summer palace, the Schloss Morgenhain, in the Hochdeutsche Alps. Full security will be guaranteed for all attending.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Waffenstillstandsbedingungen[/b]]

For a ceasefire, the Kaiserreich proposes the following terms:

The ceasefire will last for five days or 120 hours beginning on January 28th, 10:00 PM local time, 

All Sikirskian military assets will move 1,500 km off the coast off Kaiserreich territory, 

Combatants will be prohibited from engaging in any conflict, 

The Reichswehr will still be permitted to engage insurgents, non-uniformed armed combatants and take any measure necessary to counter insurgents,[/spoiler]
